## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 10 июл. 2026 г. - 19 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Victor Aguirre_, 19 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Before the update, the Planet Fitness app was already great as I was easily able to access my membership as well as the guest pass. Not only that, but I was able to easily log my exercise activity. Yesterday, hours after I updated the app, I went to my local PF gym and after checking in, there is a loading screen that is so slow that now I have to lose a few seconds of my time just to get access to the guest membership pass. Not to mentioned the fact that the exercise log removed some workouts."
            2. _Sylvia Molina_, 18 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I hate this app. I'm regularly charged late fees because the app crashes a lot. Whenever I try using the "Support" option, it tells me that my connection isn't working and that I need to connect to WiFi and when I do it still gives me a can't connect message. I'm convinced that this is why my bank account isn't being charged on the 17th of each month and there's no option to pay until it's late on the App. I'm sure the company purposely does this to get more money out of us in late fees."
            3. _AJey Calloway_, 18 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined planet fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter planet fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
<!--/ir-theme-->
